amendment: Preserves revision 6 and adds three passive NIFTY/Gold drawdown-control frontiers: 8%, 10%, and 12% close triggers cut exposure from 60% to 30%, with recovery at half the trigger, all at the next open. All thresholds are observed prospectively; no threshold is selected from the inspected historical sample. Frozen before the 2026-10-27 close; paper execution begins 2026-10-28.

portfolios.passive_nifty_gold_22_5_each: Buy 22.5% NAV of NIFTYBEES and 22.5% NAV of GOLDBEES at the first paper-session next-open fill; hold the units without rebalancing; initial gross exposure 45%, allowed cap 100% as exposure drifts
portfolios.passive_drawdown_8pct_cut_60_to_30: Start at 60% gross exposure in equal NIFTYBEES and GOLDBEES; after close NAV drawdown reaches 8%, cut to 30% at the next open; recover at -4% close drawdown, at the next open
portfolios.passive_drawdown_10pct_cut_60_to_30: Start at 60% gross exposure in equal NIFTYBEES and GOLDBEES; after close NAV drawdown reaches 10%, cut to 30% at the next open; recover at -5% close drawdown, at the next open
portfolios.passive_drawdown_12pct_cut_60_to_30: Start at 60% gross exposure in equal NIFTYBEES and GOLDBEES; after close NAV drawdown reaches 12%, cut to 30% at the next open; recover at -6% close drawdown, at the next open
portfolios.monthly_fixed_50_50_100pct: 50% NIFTYBEES Donchian 55/20 + 50% GOLDBEES SMA200; signal changes and month-end; next-session open; 100% gross cap
portfolios.monthly_fixed_50_50_95pct: same monthly fixed sleeves and weights; 95% gross cap provides a cash-buffer control
portfolios.quarterly_fixed_50_50_100pct: same sleeves and weights; signal changes and quarter-end; next-session open; 100% gross cap
portfolios.quarterly_inverse_vol_63d_100pct: same active sleeves; inverse 63-session realized-vol split when both active, 50% when one active; signal changes and quarter-end; 100% gross cap
portfolios.quarterly_inverse_vol_63d_single65_100pc: same quarterly inverse-vol rule when both sleeves are active; 65% NAV when only one is active; signal changes and quarter-end; 100% gross cap
portfolios.quarterly_inverse_vol_63d_single65_vol16: same quarterly 65% solo-sleeve rule; at signal-change or quarter-end rebalance, scale base weights by min(1, 16% / trailing 63-session annualized volatility of lagged base-portfolio returns); next-session open; 100% gross cap
portfolios.quarterly_inverse_vol_63d_single80_vol16: same quarterly inverse-vol split when both sleeves are active; 80% NAV when one is active; at signal-change or quarter-end rebalance, scale base weights by min(1, 16% / trailing 63-session annualized volatility of the lagged unthrottled 80%-sleeve portfolio); next-session open; 100% gross cap

fees: current Upstox/NSE delivery schedule; zero cash interest
execution: paper only; no broker order placement; next-open and fixed-slippage fills are modeled
